ያርኢ: አርአየ — he shows (3ms imperfect, a-stem causative of ርእየ 'see')
ይሤኒ: ሠነየ — he is handsome, beautiful (3ms imperfect, G)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
ሠናየ: ሠናይ — good (accusative, adj. as noun) · adjective 'good, fine' agreeing with a noun (ልብሰ ሠናየ 'a fine garment')
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ገሃደ: ገሃድ — openly, evident (adjective as adverbial accusative)
ወእገሪሁ: እግር — and his foot (feet) (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', form እገሪ-; singular used collectively, so l 'foot', i 'feet')
ለጽምእየ: ጽምእ — for my thirst (ለ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
ዘኒ: ዘ — moreover, also (?) (ዘ + enclitic -ኒ; ስምዑ ዘኒ ፍካሬ 'hear, moreover, the interpretation'; ዘኒ ፍካሬሁ ስምዑ 'also its interpretation, hear'; precise force uncertain) (?)
ላዕሌሁ: ላዕለ — upon, over (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form ላዕሌ-) · 'against' (ወቀንኡ ላዕሌሁ 'and they envied him', lit. 'against him', ch. 95) (?)
ሣረረታ: ሠረረ — she founded it (3fs perfect, G, written ሣረረ + ት + -ኣ 'it'; lemma uncertain) (?)
ለምድር: ምድር — to/for the earth, or earth as object (ለ- + noun) · 'of the earth', ለ- as genitive link (ወእምስፍሓ ለምድር 'and from the breadth of the earth')
ዘበእንቲአሁ: በእንተ — for whose sake (ዘ- 'who, whose' + በእንተ with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
